commit.message:
feat(app): add built-in 3D multi-setup simulation video renderer

Add a pure-Rust, headless 3D material-removal simulation movie renderer to
`camcraft-app` exposed consistently through the CLI (`camcraft-cli
render-video`), the MCP JSON-RPC server (`render_simulation_video`), and
Boa JS job scripts (`cam.call("render_simulation_video", {...})`).

Design
------
- `crates/app/src/sim_video/` (zero new external crate dependencies):
  - `math.rs`: `Vec3`, `Mat3` (`from_quat` matching `camcraft-geometry`
    `[x, y, z, w]` layout), shortest-arc `quat_slerp` with double-cover sign
    handling, pinhole `Camera`, slab AABB intersection, and analytic
    ray-cylinder / ray-cone / ray-sphere intersections for tool rendering.
  - `voxel.rs`: persistent single-byte 3D voxel billet (`VoxelStock`) held in
    document/part frame with per-surface operation color tags (`TAG_*`),
    fast column-bound carving along `±Z` (`col_max_z`/`col_min_z`), general
    arbitrary-axis carving (`carve_oriented`) for side-on and tilted 5-axis
    moves, `mask_cylinder_z`, watertight `mask_mesh` ray-parity masking,
    3x3x3 occupancy gradient normals, and neighborhood ambient occlusion.
  - `plan.rs`: extracts generated setups, `setup_align::stored` inverse
    rigid alignments, WCS labels (`G54`..`G59`/`G54.1P*`) and origins,
    `StockShape::{Box, Cylinder, FromModel}`, tool shapes (`Flat`, `Ball`,
    `Bull`, `Drill`, `Chamfer`), chord-tessellated `Move::segments3` arcs,
    optional 5-axis tilted `Move.axis`, and part mesh volume across aligned
    setups.
  - `render.rs`: `rayon`-parallel 3D DDA ray-marcher (Amanatides-Woo) with
    studio floor grid & drop shadow, Blinn-Phong metallic shading, contact
    cutting glow, spinning fluted analytic cutters/shanks/holders, and a
    depth-tested live 3D toolpath ribbon trail (blue feed, amber plunge, red
    rapid).
  - `hud.rs`: clean-room 5x7 ASCII bitmap font rendering the setup/op top
    bar, tool/RPM/feed badge, WCS DRO readout, volume tracker, `M0 STOP`
    transition banners, and segmented operation progress bar with responsive
    layout clamping for narrow resolutions (e.g. 640x360).
  - `encode.rs`: dual frame sinks supporting pure-Rust RGB8 PNG frame
    sequences (`format = "frames"`, zero external tools required) and raw
    RGB24 streaming to `ffmpeg` for `.mp4` (`libx264`), `.webm` (`libvpx`),
    and `.gif` (two-pass palette filter).
  - `mod.rs`: orchestrator with proportional `sqrt(len)` op frame budgeting,
    quaternion SLERP setup re-orientation animations, auto-azimuth framing
    for asymmetric side-turned setups (`setup_az_bias`), single-pass frame
    teeing for `--per-setup` split videos, silent prior-setup carry replay
    for `--setup <name>`, turntable showcase spin (with upright return for
    side-turned final setups), optional PNG keyframe capture, and explicit
    validation/refusal checks (resolution bounds, even dimensions for
    `yuv420p` mp4/webm, `fps`, `cell_mm`, 120M voxel cap).
- Wiring & safety gates:
  - `crates/app/src/mcp/video.rs` & `mcp/tools.rs`: registers
    `render_simulation_video` (schema with `additionalProperties: false`).
  - `crates/app/src/mcp/live.rs`: gates `render_simulation_video` under
    `GateKind::FileWrite` for live GUI MCP approval parity (#1942).
  - `crates/app/src/cli_video.rs` & `cli.rs`: adds `camcraft-cli render-video`
    to `TOP_USAGE` and `HELP_LANES` (thin wrapper generating `cam.load` /
    optional `cam.generate` / `cam.call("render_simulation_video", ...)`).
  - Regenerated `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` (`117 -> 118` tools) and updated
    `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md`.

Testing
-------
- New internal unit test suite `crates/app/src/sim_video/tests.rs` (16 tests):
  - `Mat3::from_quat` parity against `camcraft_geometry::quat_rotate_point`
    and orthogonality checks; `quat_slerp` double-cover & midpoint angle.
  - Camera projection & behind-camera rejection; AABB, cylinder (side +
    both endcaps), cone, and sphere analytic ray intersections.
  - `SimTool::radius_at` across all 5 cutter shapes (`Flat`, `Ball`, `Bull`,
    `Drill`, `Chamfer`).
  - `mask_cylinder_z` and `mask_mesh` volumes vs. analytic expectations.
  - Parity check of fast `+Z` / `-Z` column carvers against arbitrary-axis
    `carve_oriented` (plus a tilted 5-axis axis vector), tag painting,
    `solid_count` consistency, and outward `smooth_normal`.
  - `VideoFormat` parse/resolve cases, `per_setup_path` sanitization, valid
    RGB8 PNG output, tiny/out-of-bounds HUD safety, narrow 640px footer
    non-overlap guard, `draw_line_2d` z-buffer occlusion dimming, option
    validation, op frame weighting, `setup_az_bias`, and `render_frame`
    rendering across all 5 tool shapes with sparks & toolpath ribbon.
- New integration test suite `crates/app/tests/sim_video.rs` (8 hermetic
  tests using pure-Rust `format = "frames"`, zero `ffmpeg` required):
  - Single-setup render + `cam.call` JS bridge & PNG header verification.
  - 3-setup upright (`G54`) / 180° flip / -90° side-on render via MCP
    `tools/call`, checking monotonic volume reduction, part mesh volume
    across aligned setups, `--per-setup` directory PNG counts matching
    report, keyframes, and `--setup` filter silent carry parity.
  - `StockShape::Cylinder` and `StockShape::FromModel` initial volumes.
  - Helical `Bore` (expanded `segments3` chords) + `Drill` toolpath video.
  - All 4 `CameraView` presets plus `hud` and `toolpath` pixel-diff checks.
  - Live `GateKind::FileWrite` check and full refusal matrix (ungenerated op,
    unknown setup, unknown MCP arg, odd `mp4`/`webm` dimensions, zero/tiny
    `cell_mm` hitting 120M voxel cap, out-of-range `fps`, CLI exit codes).
- Existing regression suites: `camcraft-app --lib` (313 passed), `cli` (13),
  `mcp_doc_drift` (6), `ai_guide` (3), `mcp_live` (14), `mcp_render` (5),
  plus `cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-app -- -D warnings`: 0 warnings.
- Rendered real outputs end-to-end with release `camcraft-cli render-video`:
  - 3-setup double-ear clevis bracket (`960x540`, `30 fps`, `0.25 mm` voxel
    pitch, `424x288x288` grid, `--per-setup`): 1,221 frames + 3 split MP4s +
    20 PNG keyframes in 24.9s (`549.5 -> 133.7 cm^3` vs `129.5 cm^3` CAD).
  - `examples/first-part.camproj` (`--generate`, `.webm` & `640x360` PNG
    frames): `120.0 -> 67.95 cm^3` vs `67.36 cm^3` CAD.
